name: Cardiopack
headline: Cardiopack
description:
A set for heart health. Its combination of components nourishes and energises the cells of the heart and supports the normal work of the cardiovascular system.

Includes PentoKan, Coenzyme Q10, Coral Taurine and Coral Magnesium in one pack.
howToUse: Read the instructions inside the pack before use. Course: 60 days.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: PentoKan ×3 (60 tablets), Coenzyme Q10 ×1 (60 capsules), Coral Taurine ×1 (60 capsules), Coral Magnesium ×1 (90 capsules).

fullDescription:
Cardiopack is a comprehensive set designed to support cardiovascular health by providing key nutrients that help maintain normal heart function and promote healthy circulation.*

PENTOKAN
Pentokan provides potassium, ribose, and vitamin C in convenient effervescent tablets designed for efficient absorption.* Potassium helps maintain normal fluid balance within cells and supports healthy muscle and nervous system function, while vitamin C contributes antioxidant support to help protect cells from oxidative stress.*

COENZYME Q10
Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) is a naturally occurring compound found in the mitochondria—the “powerhouses” of cells that produce energy in the form of ATP. CoQ10 supports normal cellular energy production and helps protect cells from oxidative stress.* It also supports heart and circulatory function and may help maintain physical endurance during exercise.*

CORAL TAURINE
Taurine supports electrolyte balance (sodium, potassium, magnesium) and provides antioxidant support for cells.* It may help support normal cholesterol levels already within the healthy range and promote cardiovascular function with its role in vascular health.*

CORAL MAGNESIUM
Coral Magnesium provides well-absorbed forms of magnesium (taurate and glycinate) that support cardiovascular, muscular, and nervous system function.* Magnesium also contributes to normal energy metabolism and helps maintain electrolyte balance and proper cellular function.*
